correctness.rationale: Inspected the 16-state transfer matrix enforcing both local best-response equations per rung; trace(T(z)^n) bijects with labeled cyclic equilibrium profiles n>=3, including n=3 simple triangle. The source Bareiss code establishes det(I-tT)=(1-tz)^2(1-z^6t^4)(1-t-z^4t^4) by exact 17-by-33 interpolation grid with rigorous degree caps 16,32. Independently constructed its 16-state matrix and computed exact SymPy characteristic polynomials at z=0,1,2,3, matching all factors; independently enumerated every 2^(2n) action profile for n=3..8 and matched full producer histograms. Formal trace/log-derivative gives every binomial coefficient; primitive quartic companion controls exponential growth. Finite n enumeration and four specializations do not alone prove infinite formula; interpolated determinant and algebraic proof do.
